messages.author: 409dfe1554e9c224
messages.subject: Expression in labels howto?
parts:
Hi,

when doing something like this

> geom_density(aes(x=tmpResults[[PrecisionColumnName]],fill = tmpResults[["Label"]]),alpha=0.2)

where

> levels(tmpResults[["Label"]])
[1] "Xcalibur, Top 10, HCD; Median==0.11" "COM, Top 2, 3 SIM;
Median==0.04

How can I get the "==" to be parsed expression/plotmath like in the
legend labels?

Thanks, Joh

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Expression in labels howto?
parts:
Hi Johannes,

Try aes_string:

geom_density(aes_string(PrecisionColumnName, fill = "Label"), alpha = 0.2)

I assume this is part of a function or loop, where PrecisionColumnName
is a string that gives the name of the variable you want to plot.

Hadley

Yes, your assumptions were right ... thanks for the "aes_string" bit

myMovies <- movies
levels(myMovies[["mpaa"]]) <- factor(c("","NC==17","PG","PG==13","R"))
m <- ggplot(myMovies, aes(x=rating))
m + geom_density(aes_string(fill="mpaa"),alpha=0.2)

The "=="s remain just that ... how to get them parsed?

Joh
